# GIF conformance fixtures

The files in `valid/`, `invalid/`, and `edge-cases/` come from the
[`imazen/codec-corpus`](https://github.com/imazen/codec-corpus/tree/main/gif-conformance)
GIF conformance suite, commit `80a348b8a9ca2d0abcf01ddaf80106958fdea818`.

They were generated from scratch by the corpus authors and are distributed as
public-domain / CC0 test data. See the upstream
[`README.md`](https://github.com/imazen/codec-corpus/blob/main/gif-conformance/README.md)
for the expected purpose of every file.
